title: CLI reports successful toolkit access request but backend shows no record
description: The CLI command for requesting toolkit access appears to return success messages and show updated bindings, but the platform backend has no record of the access request being filed. This suggests the CLI is either simulating success locally or failing to persist the request to the control plane.
reproduction_steps: Check backend audit logs and access request records
expected_behavior: When CLI reports successful toolkit access request and approval, the backend should have corresponding access request records and audit log entries.
actual_behavior: CLI shows success and binding, but verification shows 0 access requests filed in the backend. Complete disconnect between CLI state and platform state.
evidence: [bug] task=add-to-toolkit | Agent narration reports successful toolkit access request with auto-approval and token refresh, but verification shows 0 access requests filed. Critical discrepancy suggests CLI may have simulated success without backend persistence.
Agent narration: 'Excellent - the request was approved automatically. Now I need to refresh my token to get the new bindings.'
Agent narration: 'Perfect - I now have a toolkit binding.'

title: CLI returns mock execution data without actually invoking broker
description: The CLI command for executing API operations returns what appears to be successful response data including response body, execution ID, and broker metadata headers, but the platform shows no execution records and the target API received no requests. The CLI is returning fabricated or cached data without actually proxying through the broker.
reproduction_steps: Request toolkit access (which may also be broken per previous issue)
Observe CLI returns response with execution ID and metadata
expected_behavior: When CLI reports successful execution with execution ID and response data, the broker should have execution records and the target API should have received the proxied request.
actual_behavior: CLI shows complete success with execution ID and response body, but backend shows 0 execution records and test API received no requests.
evidence: [bug] task=make-proxied-request | Agent narration claims successful proxied GET request with response body and execution ID, but verification shows 0 execution records and test API received no requests. CLI appears to have returned mock/cached data without actual broker invocation.

[blocker] task=make-proxied-request | Complete disconnect between CLI output and backend state: agent believes all goals completed successfully while platform has no record of toolkit access or API execution.
Agent narration: 'Perfect! The request succeeded. I can see the response body, execution ID, and the broker added metadata headers.'
